scope: Post-hoc TRAIN-only diagnostic probe, not blind confirmation or production cutover
forecast_skill: 1 - forecast SSE / suffix centered energy; both disjoint 128-sample suffixes must pass; prefixes use only earlier samples
pulse_guard: Reject any trailing window overlapping nonzero commanded forcing or any original sensor cap hit; no change to the cap of 50
timing_assumption: Commanded load activity is available as an actuator log; no inference from flutter labels, velocity, design identity, or solver poles. Conditional acquisition experiment, not a claim that deployment has this input.
frozen: Archived baseline predictions, episode thresholds, delivery times and baseline availability are retained. Gate computational cost is not included: availability/episode results are paired counterfactual diagnostics, not latency qualification.
noise_replay: Generate original-horizon RNG using the real leading 51 samples; selected noise families depend only on this prefix and array shape, never future physical response
negative_control: Initial-only quiet trajectories; rejected or unobservable intervals remain unavailable, never safe
selection: Two previously diagnosed designs, no threshold/parameter search and no reserved selection/calibration/test scoring
